test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

A defamation case is being filed by him against his business partner.

options.text: He has filed a defamation case against his business partner.
He has been filing a defamation case against his business partner.
He is filing a defamation case against his business partner.
His business partner is filing a defamation case against him.

solution:
The correct answer is '**He is filing a defamation case against his business partner**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and it is in the present continuous tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into an active voice, the subject '**A defamation case**' of the passive voice becomes the object, and the object 'him' becomes the subject 'He'.
 
• The passive format "is + being + V3 (filed)" should be converted into the active format "**is + present participle form of the verb (filing)**".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present continuous tense.

Hence, the correct answer is&am
